name: saas
title: SaaS kit — tenancy, activity, admin projection
description: The framework-independent backend of the Lunora SaaS kit: per-tenant tables sharded by organizationId (projects, activity), a .global() organizations projection for the cross-tenant reads a shard cannot serve, an identity claim contract carrying the caller's active organization, and the queries/mutations the dashboard and admin run on. Identity itself stays in better-auth; this item never becomes a second source of truth for it.
docs: Re-export lunora/saas/index.ts from your lunora/ entry so codegen emits api.saas.*. Then wire `resolveIdentity` in your Worker's createWorker(...) call to return { userId, activeOrganizationId, orgRole, appRole } from the better-auth session — the snippet is in lunora/identity.ts, and without it every org-scoped function fails closed with FAILED_PRECONDITION. Enable better-auth's organization() and admin() plugins in lunora/auth/index.ts, and call internal.saas.syncOrganization after an organization is created or renamed so the admin projection stays in step.
